We are extra[not]ordinary

*(ex· tra· not· or· di· nary |\ ik-ˈstr-not-ȯr-də-ˌner-ē)

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Team

Data, Digital and AI (DD&AI) supports Genmab’s business functions with the technology, data and digital capabilities they need to achieve their goals. Alongside this work, DD&AI develops and maintains the platforms, infrastructure and services that enable our teams to work effectively across the organisation.

You will join the Strategic Execution team, a global team responsible for project and portfolio management across DD&AI. Working with colleagues across Denmark, the Netherlands and the US, we help bring structure, coordination and momentum to initiatives involving multiple teams and stakeholders.

The Role

As an IT Project Manager, you will help drive DD&AI’s internal technology initiatives across areas such as cloud, security, infrastructure, data platforms and applications. You will connect leadership priorities with the work of technical teams, bringing people together to agree on what needs to be done, when and with the resources available.

The role combines planning and coordination with hands-on follow-up. You will help teams understand their dependencies, address challenges and maintain focus on agreed commitments, while giving leadership a clear view of progress and decisions needed.

Responsibilities

• Facilitate cross-functional planning sessions, including quarterly planning, to align teams on priorities, milestones and dependencies.

• Work with team leads to assess incoming demand against available capacity and develop realistic plans and timelines.

• Coordinate work across technology teams, following up on actions, risks and issues to maintain momentum.

• Track progress against agreed priorities and escalate changes or constraints that could affect delivery.

• Present clear updates, options and recommendations to leadership to support informed decisions.

• Support teams in using Agile practices and tools such as Jira to plan, track and improve their work.

Requirements

We are looking for an experienced project manager who can bring structure to complex technology initiatives and help teams move forward together. You understand how different IT areas connect and are comfortable working with both technical specialists and senior stakeholders.

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent experience.

• Experience managing complex IT projects or coordinating technology initiatives across multiple teams.

• A solid understanding of enterprise IT, including cloud computing, infrastructure and technology platforms.

• Experience with cross-functional planning, prioritisation, dependency management and resource or capacity planning.

• Experience using Agile ways of working and project management tools to plan and track work.

Experience with AWS and Jira would be valuable, as would experience in pharma or biotech. A project management certification, for example in PRINCE2, Scrum or a related methodology, is an advantage.

You are a confident communicator who can adapt your approach to different audiences. You build trust, bring people together and use your influence to reach agreement, even when you do not have direct authority. You are proactive in following up, comfortable discussing challenges and able to present practical recommendations when decisions are needed.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK563.040,00---844.560,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

The Role and Department

We are looking for a Senior CMC Project Manager to establish and coordinate Genmab’s approach to PMDA raw-data inspection readiness.

The central expectation is that you will develop, proceduralize and implement an end-to-end process that can be applied consistently:

• Across Genmab programs preparing for PMDA raw data inspections

• Across Genmab internal facilities, CMOs and CROs

A primary deliverable will be a controlled standard operating procedure (SOP), supported by practical tools, templates and training. The SOP will define the process flow, responsibilities, readiness requirements, data retrieval, review, approval and release of responses to PMDA.

You will report to the Director and team lead in Late-Stage Manufacturing Development Project Management within Genmab Tech Ops in Denmark. You will work closely with CMC, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, internal facilities and external manufacturing and testing partners.

Responsibilities

Process and SOP development

• Establish the end-to-end operating model for PMDA raw-data inspection preparation and response

• Author and coordinate approval of a controlled Genmab SOP covering the process

• Define roles, responsibilities, handoffs, decision points, escalation routes and required records

• Develop supporting work instructions, templates, trackers, readiness criteria and training

• Implement and maintain a process that can be reused across Genmab programs, internal facilities, CMOs and CROs

• Update the process based on mock inspections, PMDA requests and lessons learned

Inspection readiness

• Coordinate risk-based readiness plans with clear scope, ownership, milestones and dependencies

• Support traceability from regulatory dossier content to source documents and underlying raw data

• Confirm data ownership, storage location, responsible custodians, retention and retrieval routes

• Coordinate gap assessments, action tracking, retrieval testing and mock inspections

• Ensure readiness remains current as dossier content, stability data, source documents and systems change

Cross-functional and external coordination

• Coordinate activities across CMC, Quality, Regulatory Affairs and relevant Genmab internal facilities

• Align expectations and handoffs with CMOs, CROs and other external data-generating sites

• Coordinate rapid cross-functional responses when PMDA requests are received

• Provide clear status, risks and recommendations to program and functional governance

• Escalate risks related to unavailable records, legacy systems, archive changes or unclear ownership

**

Experience**

• Master’s degree in science, engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience. An advanced degree or relevant certification is an advantage

• Experience coordinating activities across internal functions, facilities, CMOs or CROs

• At least six years of experience in Tech Ops or a related field within a relevant industry, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

• Experience with biologics or antibody-drug conjugates is an advantage

• Solid experience managing CDMOs and contract research organizations, with a strong understanding of intellectual property implications

• Sound knowledge of pharmaceutical regulations, GMP and regulatory documentation requirements, and their application to CMC project delivery

• Experience supporting PMDA inspections is an advantage and Ability to translate regulatory and operational requirements into practical processes and tools

• Experience implementing process or system improvements, with strong proficiency in project management systems, dashboards, risk-management and reporting tools

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to present complex topics and recommendations clearly

About You

You take ownership, set clear priorities and follow through on commitments. You bring structure to complex situations, anticipate risks and use sound judgment to keep projects moving. You are comfortable influencing decisions and constructively challenging assumptions while maintaining trust.

You build relationships across functions and cultures, value a ONE-Team approach and share knowledge openly. You are curious about new approaches, including digital tools, and seek feedback and practical improvements that help colleagues and partners deliver together.

As QA Specialist for Drug Product and Finished Goods you will be responsible for the GMP quality oversight of commercial for Drug Product & Finished Goods manufactured at external Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs). The role is based in Denmark and reports to the Director, Head of QA Commercial – Drug Product & Finished Goods.

You will be part of an experienced and highly skilled QA organization, with this position holding primary accountability for Drug Product & Finished Goods across commercial supply chains. The role interfaces closely with CMOs, partners, and internal subject matter experts across Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Technical Operations, and Supply Chain, Affiliate QA.

Key Responsibilities

General Compliance

• 
Lead QA representation for Drug Product & Finished Goods in cross-functional Genmab project groups and key external collaborations, providing expert input and ensuring alignment with QA governance and regulatory expectations.

• 
Act as a QA subject matter expert on GMP for biologics Drug Product & Finished Goods, providing expert guidance, supporting resolution of complex quality issues, and ensuring consistent application of quality standards.

• 
Gain and maintain expert knowledge of applicable GMP legislation, guidelines, and industry practices relevant; assess relevance for Genmab activities and ensure structured dissemination of applicable updates to relevant stakeholders.

• 
Lead the resolution of Drug Product & Finished Goods -related quality issues in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, escalating critical or high-risk matters as appropriate to ensure timely and compliant decision-making.

Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS)

• 
Continuously improving PQS: Participate in developing, maintaining, and continuously improving Genmab’s Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS) in alignment with applicable GMP and GDP requirements.

• 
Quality Risk Management: Apply and support quality risk management principles in complex PQS activities, providing expert input to risk assessments and mitigation actions.

• 
Procedures: Review/authoring and approval of SOPs, Work Instructions, templates and forms within assigned areas.

• 
Deviation, CAPA, Change Control: Handle and support deviations, CAPAs and change controls, providing expert input and ensuring compliance with procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.

• 
Inspections & Audits: Participate in audits and inspections performed by national authorities and internal or external auditors as required.

• 
QMR: Provide expert input to Quality Management Reviews (QMRs) as part of the PQS, contributing to data analysis, trend interpretation and identification of quality risks and improvement opportunities.

• 
Complaints & Recalls: Handle and support complex product complaints and recall-related activities as part of the PQS.

• 
Batch Review & Release: Perform batch review and batch release activities and act as delegated QP and ensure compliance with procedures and regulatory requirements.

• 
APQR: Prepare, review and support complex Annual Product Quality Reviews (APQRs) as part of the PQS.

• 
Training: Provide expert training in complex or specialized quality topics as defined by QA, supporting consistent understanding and application of quality requirements.

Supplier Quality Oversight

• Provide expert and operational supplier quality oversight for Drug Product and Finished Goods manufacturers, including supplier audits, vendor risk evaluations, Quality Agreements, supplier meetings, and external notifications.

• Provide expert input to the resolution of complex -related supplier quality issues, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and Genmab quality standards.

jobs.occupation: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

• 
EASA ATPL or CPL

• 
Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

• 
Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

• 
CRI/SPA ME, or

• 
IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

• 
EASA ATPL or CPL

• 
CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

• 
ME qualification (preferred but not required)

• 
Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Chief Flight Instructor - Denmark

About the Role

This position come with

• 
Real decision-making authority over training quality and standards in a growing international organisation

• 
A direct reporting line to the Head of Training and close ties to management

• 
An established ATO with a clear, EASA-approved framework for the role

• 
Access to a modern and growing fleet

• 
An international working environment with colleagues and instructors from several countries

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

• 
CPL(A) or ATPL(A)

• 
Instructor certificate: FI(A)

• 
Additional instructor certificates such as CRI(A) and IRI(A) are considered an advantage

• 
A minimum of 1,000 hours as PIC, including at least 500 hours of instructional flying (industry practice is typically 1,500+ hours, and more experience counts in your favour)

• 
Ideally, you also have experience leading, standardising or developing other instructors

• 
Fluent English, spoken and written

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

jobs.occupation: Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S / Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S
jobs.description:
Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S vokser, og vi søger nu en stabil og ansvarsbevidst chauffør til dagdistribution. Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor kvalitet, punktlighed og god kundeservice er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

🚚 Om NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics er en transportvirksomhed med hovedsæde i Trekantsområdet. Vores centrale placering og vores dygtige medarbejdere gør os i stand til at løfte både store og små opgaver effektivt.
Vi leverer hurtige og præcise løsninger til enhver transportopgave, og med eget værksted holder vi vores biler kørende 24 timer i døgnet – samtidig med at vi holder omkostningerne nede.

🚛 Om jobbet

Vi søger en fleksibel og ansvarsfuld chauffør til vores velfungerende team. Hos os er samarbejde vigtigt – vi hjælper hinanden, så dagens opgaver løses effektivt og uden unødige problemer.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

• 
Kørsel med lastbil i dagdistribution

• 
Levering og aflæsning hos faste kunder

• 
Sortering og håndtering af gods ved pålæsning

• 
Arbejdstid typisk mellem 06:00–17:00

Du får naturligvis en grundig oplæring, hvor du kører med en af vores erfarne chauffører, så du lærer ruter, procedurer og arbejdspladsen at kende. Vi står altid klar til at hjælpe, hvis der opstår udfordringer undervejs.

🧰 Vi forventer, at du:

• 
Har kørekort C og/eller CE

•

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Statistical learning as a tool to understand host-microbiome-flavour interactions in plant growth
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and dynamic postdoc for a two-year position at the University of Copenhagen, as part of the ongoing Novo Nordisk Foundation funded project ‘Tomatoponics’. The goal of the project is to apply statistical and machine learning tools to multi-omics data including plant genotypes, root microbiomes and fruit shotgun metabolomes to better understand how the host and microbiome affect the fruit flavour. We aim to go beyond genotype-phenotype associations to reveal causal pathways, that will be tested in future trials.

  The candidate will be principally advised by Assoc. Prof. Shyam Gopalakrishnan, who leads the FindingPheno project based at the Center for Evolutionary Hologenomics (https://ceh.ku.dk), with additional guidance from Prof Tom Gilbert, Director of the Center. The Gopalakrishnan research group focuses on using population and statistical genetics to understand genotype-phenotype associations with a special focus on the role of microbiomes in evolutionary processes.

  Information on the department can be found at https://globe.ku.dk.

  Your job

  You will analyse a pre-generated dataset consisting of root metagenomes, resequenced plant genomes, untargeted fruit metabolomes plus other phenotypic data from a dataset of 10 cultivars exposed to 4 different microbiome treatments. The first part of the project will focus on performing exploratory analyses to understand the relationship between host genomic processes and microbiome variations that have a significant impact on the plant fruit chemistry and other phenotypes, with a particular focus on host-microbiome interactions. Subsequently, statistical and machine learning models will be applied to better understand the biological mechanisms and pathways involved, to help design a second trial aimed at testing predictions generated from the data.

  Our research

  As part of the projects, the postdoctoral fellow will collaborate with the wider team, that additionally includes researchers at the Department of Food Science (UCPH), Aarhus University and Aalborg University. The candidate will also have an opportunity to interact with the tomato industry, such as Danish based growers. Thus, teamwork and collaboration will be important skills; however, the candidate will also be given ownership over their own research project and deliverables.

  The fully funded postdoctoral fellowship will be hosted at the Section for Hologenomics/Center for Evolutionary Hologenomics at the GLOBE Institute. As such the candidate will also have the opportunity to collaborate with leaders in the fields of world leading experts in population genetics, statistical genetics, computational biology, clinical microbiology, archaeology, evolutionary genomics, and many other related fields of research. The University of Copenhagen is a world-leading institution of higher learning and provides excellent programs in genetics, archaeology, statistics, computer science and mathematics.

  Profile 
 We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following competencies and experience:

  Essential experience and skills:

   	
• PhD degree or equivalent doctorate, with a background in one or more of the following areas: statistics, data science, statistical genetics, computational biology, bioinformatics, computer science, and/or mathematics 	
• Demonstrated working proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used in data science (e.g. Python, R, C/C++, Java or Julia) 	
• Experience working in the UNIX operating environment 	
• Excellent English skills written and spoken   Desirable experience and skills:

   	
• Previous experience or strong interest in working with large scale biological data such as genomics, metagenomics, multi-omics, etc. 	
• Experience with high-performance computing clusters/systems 	
• Experience with compiling and working with data from different sources 	
• Understanding of FAIR data principles, interest in Open Data 	
• Interest in scientific communication and/or public outreach   Place of employment

  The place of employment is at the Section for Hologenomics, Oester Farimagsgade 5, 1353 Copenhagen C.

  About Globe Institute
 The Globe Institute is part of the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences at the University of Copenhagen. The Institute’s main purpose is to address basic scientific questions through interdisciplinary approaches. The institute operates at the intersection of natural and medical sciences and the humanities. Information on the institute can be found at: http://www.globe.ku.dk/.

  The Globe Institute is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment where employees and students can belong and thrive. See website for more information. All qualified applicants will receive full consideration. Candidates who, through their research, teaching, and/or service, contribute to diversity and competencies of our Institute are encouraged to apply. The University of Copenhagen strives to offer a family friendly and flexible working environment with a sustainable balance between work- and private life, including parental leave schemes (up to 47 weeks for both parents) and up to six weeks of paid holidays per year. Researchers that have not been tax liable in Denmark for the last 10 years can apply for a special (reduced) tax scheme. The university offers a variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families.

  Terms of employment 
 The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  The psoition is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 2 years. The starting date is on 1st of April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

  Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Questions
 For further information please contact Assoc. Prof. Shyam Gopalakrishnan: shyam.gopalakrishnan@sund.ku.dk  and/or Prof. Tom Gilbert: tgilbert@sund.ku.dk .

  Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

  Application procedure
 Your online application must be submitted in English by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. Furthermore, your application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page). 	
• CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position. 	
• A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do.

jobs.description:

Title:
Metabolite Imaging at Cellular Resolution

Research area and project description:
This project will develop advanced methods and open-source tools for processing, analysing and interpreting MSI and spatial metabolomics data, particularly for small molecules metabolites at cellular resolution. The methods will be applied to tissue sections, microbial communities, environmental samples to understand spatial control of metabolites and their flux in an organ system.

The successful candidate will work at the interface of computational science, biochemistry, microbiology and analytical chemistry. The project will combine analytical and computational method development with experimental spatial metabolomics workflow combining MALDI-MS, tissue staining and microscopic imaging. The PhD student will join an interdisciplinary team of chemists, microbiologists, biologists and computational scientists and contribute to both methodological development and biological applications.

The position includes:
• Developing mass spectrometry imaging workflows to achieve cellular resolution.
• Integrating various imaging and staining modalities with MSI.
• Collaborating with computational scientists and biologists to validate methods against experimental and biological datasets. Ensure reliable implementation of automated quality control, testing, documentation and reproducibility reporting.
• Communicating computational results clearly to interdisciplinary and non-computational researchers. Processing and analysing imaging datasets and presenting results at internal and international scientific meetings.
• Publishing methodological and application studies and releasing well-documented open-source soft-ware.
• Close supervision and collaboration with dedicated researchers and senior investigators.
Qualifications and specific competences:
We are seeking highly motivated candidates with a strong interest in interdisciplinary research. Applicants should hold a master’s degree (or equivalent) in computer science, bioinformatics/ cheminformatics, AI/ML, da-ta science, chemistry, computational biology, chemometrics, analytical chemistry or a related discipline.

Essential qualifications:
• Solid background in analytical chemistry, biotechnology, mass spectrometry, omics data analysis and/or mass spectrometry

jobs.occupation: PhD fellowship/scholarship - Integration of view-out quality and privacy assessment in building design activities
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Civil and Architectural Engineering programme. The position is available from 1 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title:
Integration of view-out quality and privacy assessment in building design activities

Research area and project description:
The aim of this Ph.D. project is to develop methods for designing facades and surrounding landscapes with a regenerative environmental impact under future climate scenarios. The objective is to develop a model that predicts occupants’ satisfaction with view-out quality and visual privacy for different combinations of façade and landscape design, and to integrate it into existing indoor environmental quality (IEQ) models. Combined with assessments of material use and life-cycle environmental impacts, the model will help designers identify solutions that offer the best trade-offs between maximising occupant satisfaction and minimising the material demand and environmental impacts of the building and landscape elements. The hypothesis is that façade and landscape designs which achieve higher occupant satisfaction with both view-out quality and visual privacy are less likely to be altered in response to dissatisfaction with either aspect. This resilience is expected to extend the functional longevity of the original design and reduce the additional material use and environmental impacts associated with such alterations.

The methodological approach to establish the model will be a combination of user perception experiments on the perception of view quality and visual privacy through windows in facade systems in both lab experiments and field studies. Co-creation techniques are applied to engage with the building industry to integrate and test the model in practical design methods and workflows for climate-resilient design of buildings under future climate scenarios.
The background for the project is that the planetary boundaries are overstepped due to excessive environmental load from human activities, which means that humanity has entered a zone of risk of deleterious or even catastrophic environmental change at continental to global scales. The main driver for this is the built environment that e.g. accounts for approx. 43% of all energy-related CO2-emissions. There is therefore an acute need to reduce the environmental load from the built environment to a level that enables the regenerative properties of the planetary ecosystems to reestablish the safe operating space below the planetary boundaries.

Qualifications and specific competences:
The candidate must have an M.Sc. degree or similar in architectural engineering. Applicants are expected to have at least five years of experience from building design practice. Documented experience in digital building modelling and practical experience in user involvement processes is mandatory. Experience with evaluation of view-out quality and privacy in design practice is preferred.

Truck driver for foodservice company

Fresh and energetic truck driver colleagues are wanted for a foodservice company.

jobs.occupation: Lastbilchauffør (C/CE) / Truck Driver (C/CE)– Stabrand Spedition, Nordhavn
jobs.description:
Lastbilchauffører søges til Stabrand Spedition i Nordhavn

Vi søger flere lastbilchauffører til vores kørselsafdeling med udgangspunkt fra Skagerrakvej 8, 2150 Nordhavn.

Hos Stabrand Spedition får du en hverdag, hvor dagene ikke nødvendigvis ligner hinanden. Vi kører både stykgods, part loads, full loads samt skibscontainere på chassis og med sideloader, primært på Sjælland.

Du får som udgangspunkt fast tilknyttet bil, som du har ansvar for i det daglige. Du bliver samtidig en del af et godt chaufførteam, hvor man hjælper hinanden, taler ordentligt sammen og har tæt kontakt med vores disponenter.

Arbejdsdagen

Arbejdsdagen starter normalt omkring kl. 06.00-06.30 i Nordhavn.

Opgaverne varierer efter, hvad der skal køres den pågældende dag. Det kan være stykgods den ene dag, part- eller full load den næste og containerkørsel en tredje.

Derudover følger de almindelige chaufføropgaver selvfølgelig med: af- og pålæsning, lastsikring, håndtering af trailer og containere, dokumenter samt almindelig kontrol og pasning af bilen og udstyret.

Vi leder efter dig, der er mødestabil, tager ansvar for dit arbejde og kan arbejde selvstændigt. Du skal passe ordentligt på bilen og materiellet og være indstillet på, at planen nogle gange ændrer sig i løbet af dagen.

Som chauffør er du ofte den person fra Stabrand Spedition, som vores kunder møder. Derfor betyder det også noget for os, at du er ordentlig i din omgang med kunderne og repræsenterer virksomheden på en god måde.

Engelsk er et krav. Dansk er en fordel, men ikke nødvendigt.

Har du erfaring med containerkørsel, stykgods eller anden godskørsel, er det selvfølgelig en fordel.

Kørekort og certifikater

Når du søger, vil vi gerne have et klart overblik over, hvad du har af kørekort og beviser.

·   dine kørekortkategorier og udløbsdato

·   eventuelt chaufføruddannelsesbevis / EU-kvalifikationsbevis og udløbsdato

·   førerkort til digital takograf og udløbsdato

·   eventuelt ADR-bevis

·   eventuelt krancertifikat

·   andre relevante certifikater eller uddannelser

ADR og krancertifikat er en fordel, men ikke et krav til alle vores opgaver.

Hvad får du hos os?

Du får en fuldtidsstilling med udgangspunkt i Nordhavn, primært kørsel på Sjælland, forskellige typer transportopgaver og en fast tilknyttet bil.

Du bliver en del af en virksomhed, hvor transport hænger tæt sammen med vores terminal-, lager- og 3PL-aktiviteter. Det giver en hverdag med mange forskellige typer opgaver og korte veje mellem chauffører, disponenter og resten af organisationen.

Ansøgning

Send os en kort ansøgning eller præsentation af dig selv sammen med dit CV på tobias@stabrand.dk eller ring på 39209030 for spørgsmål vedrørende stillingen.

Husk at angive dine kørekortkategorier, udløbsdatoer og relevante certifikater.

Vi indkalder løbende relevante kandidater til samtale.

***ENGLISH BELOW***

Truck Drivers Wanted for Stabrand Spedition in Nordhavn

We are looking for additional truck drivers to join our transport department, based at Skagerrakvej 8, 2150 Nordhavn.

At Stabrand Spedition, no two days are necessarily the same. We handle groupage, part loads, full loads and shipping containers on chassis and sideloaders, mainly across Zealand.

As a general rule, you will have a truck assigned to you and be responsible for it in your day-to-day work. You will also join a good team of drivers where people help each other, communicate properly and work closely with our dispatchers.

The working day

The working day normally starts around 06:00-06:30 in Nordhavn.

The jobs vary depending on what needs to be transported that day. One day may involve groupage, the next a part or full load, and another day container transport.

The usual driver duties are naturally part of the job as well: loading and unloading, securing cargo, handling trailers and containers, paperwork, and normal daily checks and care of the truck and equipment.

We are looking for someone who turns up on time, takes responsibility for the job and is comfortable working independently. You should take good care of the truck and equipment and be prepared for plans to change during the day from time to time.

As a driver, you are often the person from Stabrand Spedition our customers meet. It therefore matters to us that you deal with customers properly and represent the company in a professional and positive way.

English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Experience with container transport, groupage or other types of goods transport is an advantage.

Driving licence and certificates

When applying, please give us a clear overview of your driving licence and certificates.

·   your driving licence categories and expiry date

·   any driver qualification card / EU Certificate of Professional Competence and expiry date

·   digital tachograph driver card and expiry date

·   any ADR certificate

·   any crane certificate

·   other relevant certificates or qualifications

ADR and crane certificates are an advantage, but they are not required for all of our assignments.

What we offer

This is a full-time position based in Nordhavn, with driving mainly across Zealand, a varied mix of transport assignments and, a truck assigned to you only.

You will join a company where transport works closely together with our terminal, warehouse and 3PL activities. This creates a varied working day and short lines of communication between drivers, dispatchers and the rest of the organisation.

Application

Send us a short application or introduction together with your CV to tobias@stabrand.dk or contact us via +45 39209030 for questions regarding the position.

Please remember to include your driving licence categories, expiry dates and relevant certificates.

We invite suitable candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.
